sloka: स एष सुमहाकाय: कम्पते वाहिनीमुखे।नाग: शत्रुञ्जयो नाम वृद्धस्तातस्य धीमत: ॥ २.९७.२५॥
transliteration: sa eṣa sumahākāya: kampate vāhinīmukhe।nāga: śatruñjayo nāma vṛddhastātasya dhīmata: ॥ 2.97.25॥

translations.english: There is that huge and aged elephant named Satrunjaya which belogns to our sagacious father proceeding at the head of the army.
